title: The four-fifths rule is not disparate impact: A woeful tale of epistemic trespassing in algorithmic fairness
findings: The paper does not have any findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned only once in passing as an example of a protected attribute under U.S. law, and it is not central to the paper's argument.
